meta.name: RPSGT V3 Core Library Audit
meta.purpose: Separate current BRPT recommendation status, Sleep Pathways Guild library availability, V3 outline status, and current-authority status so editions and source roles are never silently conflated.
meta.lockedPrinciple: A source may be BRPT-listed, present in the library, deeply outlined, or current authority; those are separate properties.
meta.copyrightBoundary: Store bibliographic metadata, public section/category names, original SPG outlines, and verified locators only. Do not copy proprietary textbook questions, cases, figures, tables, scoring rules, or substantial protected passages.

auditFindings: The current BRPT recommended-reading universe is now almost fully structurally represented in V3; the main exact-edition structuring gap is Sleep Medicine Pearls, Third Edition.
All 13 BRPT-listed AASM guidance families now have a structured V3 source identity, including explicit legacy/current boundaries where appropriate.
ICSD-3-TR is a first-class V3 diagnostic source and must remain distinct from the older full ICSD-3 library copy.
Pediatric Sleep Pearls is now verified in the Guild Drive and structured as pediatric study support.
Sleep Medicine Pearls, Second Edition is approved for provisional teaching use, while Third Edition access is user-confirmed in Kindle and remains a future outline task.
Fundamentals remains valuable; the goal is not to suppress it artificially but to strengthen exact/current source routing so it is used when it is genuinely the best study support.
